## notegen-docs.md
---
tags:
  - tool:notegen
  - theme:reference
  - type:reference
  - status:active
  - maturity:stable
---
# NoteGen Documentation Hub (ingested 2026-09-07)

**Sources (14):** <https://notegen.top/en/docs/preview/canvas>, <https://notegen.top/en/docs/guides/first-note>, <https://notegen.top/en/docs/preview/record>, <https://notegen.top/en/docs/preview/chat>, <https://notegen.top/en/docs/preview/files>, <https://notegen.top/en/docs/settings/sync> (duplicate removed), <https://notegen.top/en/docs/settings/mcp>, <https://notegen.top/en/docs/preview/activity> (duplicate removed), <https://notegen.top/en/docs/settings/memories>, <https://notegen.top/en/docs/settings/prompt>, <https://notegen.top/en/docs/settings/file-manager>, <https://notegen.top/en/docs/settings/skills>, <https://notegen.top/en/docs/settings/chat>, <https://notegen.top/en/docs/settings/canvas>
**Accessed:** 2026-09-07  
**Type:** reference — distilled (not verbatim dump)

> Ingested on request over ACP into both the Obsidian vault and this OK project. Previous `references/notegen-official-docs.md` and `references/notegen-deep.md` remain; this page is the settings+preview deep-dive.

## Records — Capture Before Structure

- Seven types: Text, Voice (STT), Scan (OCR/VLM), Image, Link, File, Todo.
- Every record belongs to a tag; deleting a tag moves records to Trash.
- Views: list/compact/card; filters by tag, search, time (today/7d/30d/all), type.
- AI Organization: select records → Organize → choose template/range → set title/location/options (include images, retain links, strip thinking) → generate Markdown. Source records preserved.
- Templates have name/enabled/default-range/prompt; Quick organize skips selection. Drag records into editor; Agent can query/create/update/organize records via tools (approval-gated).

## First-Note Workflow

1. Capture (mix types, tag related). 2. Filter + multi-select, exclude private/dupes. 3. Organize into Markdown (choose folder/name/template, dedicated prompts under Organize Template). 4. Review headings/facts/links/todos/images (AI can omit). 5. Continue editing, polish/shorten/expand/translate, drag files, or use Agent diffs. Saves auto; export ZIP before first sync.

## File Manager

- Unified workspace tree; desktop status bar switches workspaces + shows sync. New files/folders get non-conflicting names.
- Context menus: rename/copy/cut/paste/delete/reveal/sync ops; drag to move or into editor.
- Import: directory (recursive Markdown+images, collision-checked), Notion ZIP (Markdown/CSV), Document→Markdown (Word/Excel/PPT/ODF/RTF/EPUB/CSV/PDF — complex/scanned may need OCR).
- Workspace: default inside app-data; custom any RW directory; history with clear; restart after switch; switching does not move files.
- Sort by name/ctime/mtime; expand/collapse all; KB index controls: calc/delete vectors, toggle auto-vectors, exclude file, batch folder vectors, show stats. `skills/` dir loaded as Skills not KB docs.
- Sync provider: GitHub/Gitee/GitLab/Gitea/S3/WebDAV/cloud-folder/self-hosted; different workspaces can map to different repos.
- Export Markdown/HTML/txt/JSON/PDF; unsupported files open externally.

## Chat and Agent

- Chat: model, prompt, language, linked tag/files, MCP, KB, web search, clipboard monitor, new/clear context/clear chat. Context tray shows linked files/records/memory/KB/tools. Auto-condensation summarizes older messages after threshold.
- Agent loop: understand → plan → tool-use → check. Tools: read/create/modify Markdown, folders, query/manage tags/records/chats, memory, system/workspace info, MCP tools. Timeline shows plan/args/results; failed runs continue with preserved context; queue while running.
- Permissions: read vs mutate; approval panel (allow once / session / reject); editor diffs require accept; multi-file reviewable item-by-item.
- Context: New Chat keeps history; Clear Context excludes earlier msgs; reduce linked files/disable KB/MCP or new chat when context bloats.
- MCP/Skills/KB/Memory/Web Search combinable but expand egress — review privacy.

## Canvas

- Top-level workspace alongside Records/Writing; editable nodes, connectors, drawings, charts. Templates: flowchart, mind map, timeline, quadrant, Kanban, SWOT.
- Tools: Select/Hand, pen/highlighter/eraser, text/image/group/shapes, connectors with labels, drag from Records or Files, charts from manual data or selected notes (needs chat model — data sent to provider).
- Properties: text/color/border/opacity/layer/size/alignment; align/distribute, save as custom component.
- Layout: auto-layout (directional), minimap, grid/snap, zoom/fit/marquee. Import canvas JSON or Mermaid flowchart/graph; export PNG/SVG, image record, canvas JSON (lossless), Mermaid flowchart (lossy — strokes/images/charts/groups not preserved).
- Storage in app data with thumbnails; syncs with structured data when Records+Settings sync enabled.
- Settings: grid/minimap/zoom, snap, grid style (dots/lines/none) & gap 8–48px, default zoom, wheel pan/zoom, after-insert behavior, manager view/sort.

## Activity

- Heatmap + daily timeline for records/writing/chat events (heatmap counts events, not words/time). Open via desktop activity panel or mobile Me→Activity; select day for timeline. Events stay even if source deleted. Local storage; included in Records/Settings sync if enabled.

## Sync

- What syncs: Markdown+assets (file-level upload/pull/delete/delayed auto-sync) vs Records/tags/chats/canvases/settings (ordered queue with conflict detection). Device-specific paths/UI scale excluded; Exclude Sensitive removes tokens/passwords/MCP/image-host.
- Providers: GitHub/Gitee/GitLab/Gitea (GitHub fine-grained PAT Contents RW, Admin to create), S3 (key/secret/region/bucket/endpoint/prefix), WebDAV (URL/user/pass/prefix), OneDrive/iCloud Drive (local cloud folder or iOS migrate to iCloud container), self-hosted (experimental, dev-mode, URL+library/members/devices, verify HTTPS/recovery key/library match, backup first).
- Multiple workspaces can map to separate repos; verify mapping after switch.
- Note auto-sync: disable or 2s–2m delay; optional pull on open/switch (can overwrite). Records/settings auto-sync: ordered queue; first-enable choose Upload/Pull/Later.
- Conflicts: Merge (keep both, newer wins for same record), Pull-over-local, Upload-over-remote. Export ZIP before risky overwrite.

## Settings Highlights

- **MCP**: stdio (desktop, command+args+JSON env) or HTTP (desktop+mobile, URL+headers); add/disable/import mcpServers JSON/test before save; tool browser + per-conversation selector; Access NoteGen exposes local Streamable HTTP on 127.0.0.1:3456 (default 37422) for Claude Desktop/Codex — Bearer token.
- **Skills**: reusable Agent Skills (SKILL.md, slash visibility, allowed tools); Global vs Workspace (`skills/` workspace-only, backed up/synced, not KB-indexed); ZIP import/export; Auto-Match on description.
- **Memories**: Preference (every conversation) vs Memory (embedding-matched); add manually or via Agent “remember this”, dedup on similarity; requires embedding model (online provider sees text).
- **Prompt**: system instructions; library for Organize/Rewrite/Summarize etc; selectable in Chat dropdown; AI optimization; deletion final.
- **File Manager Settings**: workspace path, history, assets folder name (affects new assets only).
- **Chat/General**: close action, launch at startup, theme (light/dark/system), language, font, scales, proxy, import/export config.
- **Canvas Settings**: grid/snap/minimap/style/gap/zoom, wheel behavior, after-insert tool, manager view/sort.

## Sources

All 14 requested URLs (2 duplicates deduplicated): canvas (×2), first-note, record, chat, files, sync, mcp, activity (×2), memories, prompt, file-manager, skills, chat, canvas. Extracted via HTML render parse 2026-09-07.

Related: [[references/notegen-official-docs]] · [[references/notegen-deep]] · [[comparisons/notegen]]

- Tools: Select/Hand, pen/highlighter/eraser, text/image/group/shapes, connectors with labels, drag from Records or Files, charts from manual data or selected notes (needs chat model — data sent to provider).
- Properties: text/color/border/opacity/layer/size/alignment; align/distribute, save as custom component.
- Layout: auto-layout (directional), minimap, grid/snap, zoom/fit/marquee. Import canvas JSON or Mermaid flowchart/graph; export PNG/SVG, image record, canvas JSON (lossless), Mermaid flowchart (lossy — strokes/images/charts/groups not preserved).

- Settings: grid/minimap/zoom, snap, grid style (dots/lines/none) & gap 8–48px, default zoom, wheel pan/zoom, after-insert behavior, manager view/sort.

- Heatmap + daily timeline for records/writing/chat events (heatmap counts events, not words/time). Open via desktop activity panel or mobile Me→Activity; select day for timeline. Events stay even if source deleted. Local storage; included in Records/Settings sync if enabled.

## Sync

- What syncs: Markdown+assets (file-level upload/pull/delete/delayed auto-sync) vs Records/tags/chats/canvases/settings (ordered queue with conflict detection). Device-specific paths/UI scale excluded; Exclude Sensitive removes tokens/passwords/MCP/image-host.
- Providers: GitHub/Gitee/GitLab/Gitea (GitHub fine-grained PAT Contents RW, Admin to create), S3 (key/secret/region/bucket/endpoint/prefix), WebDAV (URL/user/pass/prefix), OneDrive/iCloud Drive (local cloud folder or iOS migrate to iCloud container), self-hosted (experimental, dev-mode, URL+library/members/devices, verify HTTPS/recovery key/library match, backup first).

- Note auto-sync: disable or 2s–2m delay; optional pull on open/switch (can overwrite). Records/settings auto-sync: ordered queue; first-enable choose Upload/Pull/Later.
- Conflicts: Merge (keep both, newer wins for same record), Pull-over-local, Upload-over-remote. Export ZIP before risky overwrite.

## Records — Capture Before Structure

- Seven types: Text, Voice (STT), Scan (OCR/VLM), Image, Link, File, Todo.
- Every record belongs to a tag; deleting a tag moves records to Trash.
- Views: list/compact/card; filters by tag, search, time (today/7d/30d/all), type.
- AI Organization: select records → Organize → choose template/range → set title/location/options (include images, retain links, strip thinking) → generate Markdown. Source records preserved.
- Templates have name/enabled/default-range/prompt; Quick organize skips selection. Drag records into editor; Agent can query/create/update/organize records via tools (approval-gated).

## First-Note Workflow

1. Capture (mix types, tag related). 2. Filter + multi-select, exclude private/dupes. 3. Organize into Markdown (choose folder/name/template, dedicated prompts under Organize Template). 4. Review headings/facts/links/todos/images (AI can omit). 5. Continue editing, polish/shorten/expand/translate, drag files, or use Agent diffs. Saves auto; export ZIP before first sync.

## File Manager

- Unified workspace tree; desktop status bar switches workspaces + shows sync. New files/folders get non-conflicting names.
- Context menus: rename/copy/cut/paste/delete/reveal/sync ops; drag to move or into editor.
- Import: directory (recursive Markdown+images, collision-checked), Notion ZIP (Markdown/CSV), Document→Markdown (Word/Excel/PPT/ODF/RTF/EPUB/CSV/PDF — complex/scanned may need OCR).
- Workspace: default inside app-data; custom any RW directory; history with clear; restart after switch; switching does not move files.
- Sort by name/ctime/mtime; expand/collapse all; KB index controls: calc/delete vectors, toggle auto-vectors, exclude file, batch folder vectors, show stats. `skills/` dir loaded as Skills not KB docs.
- Sync provider: GitHub/Gitee/GitLab/Gitea/S3/WebDAV/cloud-folder/self-hosted; different workspaces can map to different repos.
- Export Markdown/HTML/txt/JSON/PDF; unsupported files open externally.

## Chat and Agent

- Chat: model, prompt, language, linked tag/files, MCP, KB, web search, clipboard monitor, new/clear context/clear chat. Context tray shows linked files/records/memory/KB/tools. Auto-condensation summarizes older messages after threshold.
- Agent loop: understand → plan → tool-use → check. Tools: read/create/modify Markdown, folders, query/manage tags/records/chats, memory, system/workspace info, MCP tools. Timeline shows plan/args/results; failed runs continue with preserved context; queue while running.
- Permissions: read vs mutate; approval panel (allow once / session / reject); editor diffs require accept; multi-file reviewable item-by-item.
- Context: New Chat keeps history; Clear Context excludes earlier msgs; reduce linked files/disable KB/MCP or new chat when context bloats.
- MCP/Skills/KB/Memory/Web Search combinable but expand egress — review privacy.

## Canvas

- Top-level workspace alongside Records/Writing; editable nodes, connectors, drawings, charts. Templates: flowchart, mind map, timeline, quadrant, Kanban, SWOT.
- Tools: Select/Hand, pen/highlighter/eraser, text/image/group/shapes, connectors with labels, drag from Records or Files, charts from manual data or selected notes (needs chat model — data sent to provider).
- Properties: text/color/border/opacity/layer/size/alignment; align/distribute, save as custom component.
- Layout: auto-layout (directional), minimap, grid/snap, zoom/fit/marquee. Import canvas JSON or Mermaid flowchart/graph; export PNG/SVG, image record, canvas JSON (lossless), Mermaid flowchart (lossy — strokes/images/charts/groups not preserved).
- Storage in app data with thumbnails; syncs with structured data when Records+Settings sync enabled.
- Settings: grid/minimap/zoom, snap, grid style (dots/lines/none) & gap 8–48px, default zoom, wheel pan/zoom, after-insert behavior, manager view/sort.

## Activity

- Heatmap + daily timeline for records/writing/chat events (heatmap counts events, not words/time). Open via desktop activity panel or mobile Me→Activity; select day for timeline. Events stay even if source deleted. Local storage; included in Records/Settings sync if enabled.

## Sync

- What syncs: Markdown+assets (file-level upload/pull/delete/delayed auto-sync) vs Records/tags/chats/canvases/settings (ordered queue with conflict detection). Device-specific paths/UI scale excluded; Exclude Sensitive removes tokens/passwords/MCP/image-host.
- Providers: GitHub/Gitee/GitLab/Gitea (GitHub fine-grained PAT Contents RW, Admin to create), S3 (key/secret/region/bucket/endpoint/prefix), WebDAV (URL/user/pass/prefix), OneDrive/iCloud Drive (local cloud folder or iOS migrate to iCloud container), self-hosted (experimental, dev-mode, URL+library/members/devices, verify HTTPS/recovery key/library match, backup first).
- Multiple workspaces can map to separate repos; verify mapping after switch.
- Note auto-sync: disable or 2s–2m delay; optional pull on open/switch (can overwrite). Records/settings auto-sync: ordered queue; first-enable choose Upload/Pull/Later.
- Conflicts: Merge (keep both, newer wins for same record), Pull-over-local, Upload-over-remote. Export ZIP before risky overwrite.

## Settings Highlights

- **MCP**: stdio (desktop, command+args+JSON env) or HTTP (desktop+mobile, URL+headers); add/disable/import mcpServers JSON/test before save; tool browser + per-conversation selector; Access NoteGen exposes local Streamable HTTP on 127.0.0.1:3456 (default 37422) for Claude Desktop/Codex — Bearer token.
- **Skills**: reusable Agent Skills (SKILL.md, slash visibility, allowed tools); Global vs Workspace (`skills/` workspace-only, backed up/synced, not KB-indexed); ZIP import/export; Auto-Match on description.
- **Memories**: Preference (every conversation) vs Memory (embedding-matched); add manually or via Agent “remember this”, dedup on similarity; requires embedding model (online provider sees text).
- **Prompt**: system instructions; library for Organize/Rewrite/Summarize etc; selectable in Chat dropdown; AI optimization; deletion final.
- **File Manager Settings**: workspace path, history, assets folder name (affects new assets only).
- **Chat/General**: close action, launch at startup, theme (light/dark/system), language, font, scales, proxy, import/export config.
- **Canvas Settings**: grid/snap/minimap/style/gap/zoom, wheel behavior, after-insert tool, manager view/sort.
